svg.text: PyTorch-native DiT inference engine - Cache + Parallelism + Quantization - vipshop/cache-dit - cache-dit.io
L1 - DiT Models + Community Integrations (built on HuggingFace Diffusers - nearly all DiTs)
L2 - Unified Entry API (one-line enable_cache - drop-in Diffusers pipeline wrapper)
Single call patches pipeline - call pipe() as normal
summary() stats - disable_cache() restore original pipe
Cache + CP/TP + Quant + compile + CUDA graphs
Compatible w/ CPU offload and Ray wrapper
L3 - BlockAdapter + Forward Pattern Matching (Pattern 0-5 - auto/custom adapter registration)
Separate cache context per blocks instance
Match DiT block loop structure in diffusers
Hybrid patterns per block list in one model
Unified cache hooks injected at matched sites
Convert unknown Pattern to known PATTERN
Fuse for-loop ops into block forward when needed
FLUX: higher threshold on single_stream blocks
Wan MoE: different warmup/cached steps per expert
Per-step refresh of cache state across denoise
Hooks wrap transformer forward at block level
FP8 comm paths for Ulysses attention
Env vars for uneven heads / seq len
L4 - Hybrid Cache Engine (residual-based step skipping - training-free acceleration)
Fn: first n blocks fit stable L1 diff at step t
Bn: last n blocks fuse approx hidden states (F8B12)
Dynamic block prune via L1 hidden state distance
Approx pruned block output from cached residuals
Taylor expansion cache for feature prediction
summary() per inference - cache hit ratio
residual diff P25/P50/P75 for threshold tuning
L5 - Parallelism Backend (CACHE_DIT backend - Context + Tensor + component parallel)
USP: Ulysses + Ring hybrid for long sequences
ulysses_async: overlap QKV proj with comm
ulysses_float8: FP8 all2all for Q/V/O tensors
TP for DiT weights - dedicated TE-P VAE-P CN-P
L6 - Quantization + Layerwise Offload + Compile (SVDQuant W4A4 - bucket CPU offload - torch.compile)
Each scheduler step: check residual diff - skip or recompute DiT blocks
Step 1: DiffusionPipeline.__call__ - scheduler produces timestep t
Step 2: Cache context refresh for step t - compare L1 residual vs threshold
Step 3a CACHE HIT: skip Fn blocks - reuse cached hidden + residual approximation
Step 3b CACHE MISS: full forward through blocks - update cache at Fn/Bn boundaries
Step 4: Optional CP/TP sharding - Ulysses all2all inside attention - gather output
Step 5: scheduler.step - VAE decode - summary() cache stats for tuning
Diffusers-native drop-in - not a replacement framework - acceleration layer on top
pip install cache-dit - enable_cache(pipe) - pipe(...) - up to 9x w/ cache + CP + compile
Design Position (PyTorch-native DiT acceleration - training-free cache - Diffusers ecosystem compatible)
BlockAdapter pattern match + DBCache residual skip + Ulysses CP + SVDQuant = fast flexible DiT serving
Init: pipe = DiffusionPipeline.from_pretrained(...) - cache_dit.enable_cache(pipe, cache_config, parallelism_config)
Loop: denoise steps - cache hit/miss per block - CP shard attn - scheduler.step - VAE decode - summary stats
Sources: github.com/vipshop/cache-dit - cache-dit.readthedocs.io - vipshop Computer Vision AI Team - 2025
